author: Plochem
body:
Hey guys,

I was just thinking if avicus had something like a friend list. It might be useful if you have friends when they are on the server so you can play with them. 

I know that the server isn't that large and you can easily find them but the friend list kinda helps if you want to know if they are online or not. 

~Plochem

replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
Yeah, they do have friends now. However, the only way to register friends is to do it through the forums. I just sent you a friend request as an example. You should now see a Red Circle with an Exclamation Point in it. Click on that and accept my friend request. Now if you want to find your friends that are IG, just do /friends.

Good Luck! :]
